checks.note: The only MCP URL points at the gateway. Default-deny egress is in place, with an explicit allow to the gateway namespace. The open 443 rule excludes private and link-local ranges. The agent gets audience-bound STS tokens and holds no server credentials. There are no stdio servers.
Gateway token validation and downstream credentials are not in this repo. The client only requests audience-bound tokens through the STS.
Gateway per-action authorization, rate limits and decision logs are not in this repo.
Gateway and policy-engine failure behavior is not in this repo. The client _rpc raises on HTTP errors and error bodies.

One process-wide tool-list cache is shared by all tenants and callers. It is not keyed by authorization context. refresh_tools (line 110) overwrites it from a service-identity token. The agent sends no Mcp-Name header and does no header-versus-body check.
Whether the gateway acts as an OAuth client, and how it handles discovery URLs, is outside this repo.

violates: Store any cached tool list or response separately for each authorization context.
